newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 15.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 60.21 points at 6,451.90 as investors sought bargains after last week's sell-off.
* Indonesia's state-owned insurance company PT Jaminan Sosial Tenaga Kerja (Jamsostek) plans to invest 1.7 trillion ($708 million) in mutual funds, Manpower Minister Abdul Latief said on Monday.
* On Monday, the Jakarta composite index fell 1.98 points to close at 635.17 points.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,404.50/05.00 at 0135 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,403.75/04.25.
* Textile firm Texmaco Perkasa and Bank Niaga after announcements of rises in their 1996 net profits.
* Conglomerate Bimantara as it was scheduled to hold a shareholders meeting later today.
* Transport firm Mitra Rajasa after reports it expected to book a 20-percent net profit growth in 1996.
* Sampoerna on market talk its first quarter sales were likely to be disappointing.
